name: ancient bronze dragon
desc: Ancient Bronze Dragon is a CR 22 dragon.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]]. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) [[/item Repulsion Breath]] or (B) [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

actions.name: repulsion breath
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=zuf9EEVj4nI1joaH]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=zuf9EEVj4nI1joaH]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=zuf9EEVj4nI1joaH]]-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 60 feet straight away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

actions.name: lightning breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-wide [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +14 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Guiding Bolt} (level 2 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShapechang]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithA]{Speak with Animals}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Thaumaturgy} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWat]{Control Water}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWaterBreat]{Water Breathing}

actions.name: guiding light
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Guiding Bolt} (level 2 version).

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.

actions.name: thunderclap
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=Lq6GexegvlEVB6Dh]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=Lq6GexegvlEVB6Dh]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Lq6GexegvlEVB6Dh]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=Lq6GexegvlEVB6Dh]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Deafened apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn.
